coverage: 2000-present: the current Governor's executive order archive from January 2023, plus earlier weather declarations added by hand from the Governor's disaster proclamations catalogued by the Arkansas State Library (2006-2011 and 2021) and dated news coverage; no declarations from 2000-2005 have been found yet, and FEMA's 2000-2004 declarations and those for February and May 2008, December 2009, May 2011 and June 2019 still have no dated state declaration
